exact_human_decision_required: The human stakeholder must select whether the Emergency Condition Detector fails closed (M-A), declares emergency mode (M-B), uses the last valid T_required (M-C), or uses a separately governed numerical fallback (M-D) when no valid T_required is available.

M-A_FAIL_CLOSED.compatibility: Compatible with CONSUMER_ONLY and POLARIS FAIL_CLOSED pattern

M-B_EMERGENCY.compatibility: Conservative for critical load, unestablished in code

M-C_LAST_VALID.compatibility: Conflicts with prohibition against unvalidated stale forward-filling

M-D_FALLBACK.compatibility: Conflicts with non-derivation directive unless separately governed
